messages:
Ellen (CSE): NebulaLabs onboarding: mobile SDK init is seeing 429s during scale test. They hit it while spinning up many background workers after a config sync. Started ~09:13 local.

nebulalabs-eng: Logs show a pattern: `2026-05-12T09:13:10Z POST /v1/chat 429 rate_limit tenant=nebulalabs session=ui-12` followed by `2026-05-12T09:13:11Z ephemeral refresh ok id=tkn_a7b` then retries. Happens across Android and iOS clients.

Ravi (SDK): Which SDK versions? Any proxy or gateway in front?

Ellen (CSE): Android SDK 0.9.8, iOS SDK 0.9.7. They use an internal edge proxy that does per-process preflight to our /ephemeral endpoint. Each app process fetches token on startup; when a release hit, lots of processes raced.

Marco (Platform): Classic preflight fanout + short-lived ephemeral window. Any recent token-service config changes? @deploy-bot last 48h?

deploy-bot: Deploy note: 2026-05-12T03:20:05Z - token-service rotated signing keys and reduced default ephemeral grace from 8s -> 4s for canary (owner: infra/token-service).

Ravi (SDK): Ok that explains it. Quick client-side fixes: 1) per-process token cache for background workers; 2) randomized init jitter (50-300ms) before first request; 3) small retry with capped backoff on 429 for init path. We can ship micro-patches for both SDKs today.

nebulalabs-eng: We can patch, but need a hot workaround. This onboarding run is critical for revenue.

Marco (Platform): Ops mitigation: we can apply a tenant-level burst allowance for nebula and temporarily increase ephemeral grace to 10s for their tenant group. ops-oncall can apply for 60 minutes.

ops-oncall: Applying tenant burst allowance and tenant-specific ephemeral_grace=10s now. Will monitor metrics (concurrent_init, token-refresh-rate).

Ellen (CSE): Sharing a small Android snippet for per-process cache we recommended: ```kotlin
// pseudo
var cachedToken: Token? = null
suspend fun getToken(): String {
  if (cachedToken != null && cachedToken!!.expiresAt > System.currentTimeMillis()) return cachedToken!!.value
  val t = fetchEphemeral()
  cachedToken = Token(t.token, System.currentTimeMillis() + 45_000)
  return t.token
}
```

Ravi (SDK): I'll open PRs: SDK-900 (android) and SDK-901 (ios) adding token-cache + init-splay + init-retry. Will mark as critical patch.

nebulalabs-eng: After ops change at 09:20 UTC, errors dropped dramatically. We're rolling the patch now and testing.

ops-oncall: Observed concurrent init spikes drop from 180 -> 12 within 5 minutes. Removing tenant override at 10:15 unless requested.

Ellen (CSE): Customer reports production runs look stable after SDK patch rollout. I'll update account health to green and schedule a renewal check-in next week. Adding KB entry about ephemeral token fanout patterns.

Ravi (SDK): Patches released: android 0.9.9, ios 0.9.8. Docs updated with recommended defaults.

Ellen (CSE): Thanks team! Good cross-team ops + SDK support. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
